capabilities: Take timestamped or named snapshots as plain Markdown files
Pick a version from snapshots, File recovery versions, or git commits
Compare versions side by side with word-level highlights and line numbers
Edit the live note while the diff is open
Restore a changed block from the earlier version with one click
disambiguation: Not a backup or version-control tool; it keeps at most a few snapshots per note and never writes to git.
extras: Reads File recovery versions through an undocumented method that could stop working after an Obsidian update; git commits are desktop-only and require git installed; snapshots are full copies, so high per-note limits are discouraged in large vaults.
intentEvidence: the automatic versions Obsidian's core File recovery plugin saves every few minutes
problem: Obsidian saves automatic File recovery versions and git history, but offers no readable side-by-side comparison of a note's earlier versions.

relations.evidence: the automatic versions Obsidian's core File recovery plugin saves
the git commits that changed the note, if your vault is a git repository

summary: Side-by-side diff tool that snapshots notes and compares them with earlier snapshots, File recovery versions, or git commits, with per-block restore.
